name: 252. Mistral rejects replayed assistant reasoning (mistral-reasoning-replay)
description: Mistral validates chat requests strictly and 422s any unknown assistant field (extra_forbidden). Once Bifrost surfaces zai-glm-5-3 thinking blocks as reasoning, clients send that reasoning back on the next turn: reasoning_content on /v1/chat/completions, a thinking block on /anthropic/v1/messages (Claude Code), a reasoning item on /v1/responses. All of them reached Mistral as assistant reasoning_content and failed every follow-up turn. Each case replays one turn of reasoning and must get a 200; the unary chat case also asserts the outbound body carries no reasoning field. Vertex-hosted Mistral shares applyMistralCompatibility and is pinned by the Go unit test only (no Vertex Mistral model in the harness profile).

item.name: mistral/zai-glm-5-3 /v1/chat/completions assistant reasoning_content replay is stripped before Mistral - mistral-reasoning-replay

exec: var body = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('replayed assistant reasoning is not rejected by Mistral', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'Mistral rejected a replayed reasoning field (extra_forbidden): ' + body).to.not.include('extra_forbidden');
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'request failed: ' + body).to.equal(200);
pm.test('reasoning_content never reaches the Mistral request body', function () {
var raw = pm.response.json().extra_fields.raw_request;
var parsed = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
var assistant = (parsed.messages || []).filter(function (m) { return m.role === 'assistant'; })[0];
pm.expect(assistant, 'no assistant message in raw_request: ' + JSON.stringify(raw)).to.not.equal(undefined);
pm.expect(assistant, 'assistant reasoning leaked to Mistral: ' + JSON.stringify(assistant)).to.not.have.any.keys('reasoning_content', 'reasoning', 'reasoning_details');
pm.expect(assistant.content, 'assistant answer text must survive the strip').to.equal('Hi! What can I help you with today?');
pm.expect(pm.response.json().choices, 'no choices returned: ' + body).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;

body.raw: {"model":"mistral/zai-glm-5-3","max_tokens":512,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"},{"role":"assistant","content":"Hi! What can I help you with today?","reasoning_content":"Simple greeting. Respond briefly."},{"role":"user","content":"Reply with just the word ok."}]}
